title: A Comprehensive Review of Datasets for Clinical Mental Health AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing the geographical origins and cultural contexts of clinical mental health datasets to identify the underrepresentation of diverse global populations and the dominance of Western and Chinese contexts.
Analyzing the linguistic diversity of mental health datasets, quantifying the overrepresentation of English and Chinese, and highlighting the scarcity or absence of other major global languages.
Assessing the diversity of patient populations within the datasets, noting that the reliance on single-institution data collections limits broad demographic representation and model generalizability.
